name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer focused on acquiring, exploring, and developing gold projects in Nevada. The company holds the Lapon Canyon and Agai-Pah properties in Mineral County, Nevada, and is in the exploration stage with an active 2026 drill program underway at Lapon Canyon. Nevada Canyon also pursues mineral royalties alongside direct project exploration in the Nevada gold belt.
